title: Built for Teams, Not Just You
tagline: Everyone sees what matters to them. Everyone shares the same truth.
body1: A project stalls for 4 days because someone missed a question buried in a Slack thread. The CEO asks "what's the status of the Henderson project?" and gets three different answers — because everyone keeps their own version of the truth. Personal AI doesn't fix any of this. Team infrastructure does.

roles.name: Dispatcher
roles.desc: Routes, crew locations, unassigned jobs. Drag-to-assign board.

roles.name: Field worker
roles.desc: Next job with directions, client history, one-tap completion.

roles.name: CEO
roles.desc: Revenue, active projects, flagged issues. Weekly AI summary.

body2: The biggest tax on small businesses isn't labor cost. It's communication latency. A 5-minute decision takes 4 days because of email chains, missed messages, and "I'll get to it when I'm back at my desk." Every feature in VOIS is designed to collapse the time between "someone needs a decision" and "the decision is made."
quote: "A company doesn't move at the speed of its fastest person. It moves at the speed of its slowest handoff."
